hero.title: Sixteen years building supply chain infrastructure for global pet supplement brands.
hero.subtitle: Henan Anjin Biotechnology Co., Ltd. operates 60,000 sqm across three GMP-certified production bases in Henan, China. We are an FDA-registered, cGMP-compliant OEM/ODM manufacturer for international pet, livestock and aquatic supplement brands.

mission.title: We exist to make global supplement supply predictable, compliant and audit-ready.
mission.subtitle: Procurement teams choose Anjin when supply continuity, regulatory documentation and formulation depth matter more than spot price.

values.title: Compliance before commerce
values.body: Every formulation is reviewed against the destination market's regulations before sampling. FDA registration, cGMP and EU CE + GPSR are baseline expectations, not selling points.

values.title: Long-term supply, not transactional supply
values.body: We design our capacity around multi-year programmes for international brands. 30% T/T deposit and 70% against B/L copy stay consistent year on year.

values.title: In-house formulation depth
values.body: 500+ active formulations on file, two provincial research centres, and partnerships with four Henan universities. New formulas develop from a written brief in 2–4 weeks.

values.title: Built for global brands, not commodity buyers
values.body: Anjin is not a low-cost workshop. We invest in documentation, traceability and process engineering — the things that survive a retailer or regulator audit.
